# Get Home Offer

> Get Home Offer helps property owners sell a home in one of two ways: a direct cash sale through the Cash Program, or a traditional sale on the open market through the Real Estate Agent Program.

- Headquarters: 1723 Waldorf Blvd, Suite 401, Madison, WI 53719
- Phone: (608) 571-4547
- Email: info@gethomeoffer.com
- Cash Program location pages: Milwaukee and Madison, Wisconsin

## Programs

- [Services](https://gethomeoffer.com/services/): Compare a direct cash sale with a traditional sale through a real estate professional.
- [Cash Program (We Buy Houses)](https://gethomeoffer.com/we-buy-houses-cash/): How a direct sale works, every situation we buy in, and the steps from inquiry to closing.
- [Real Estate Agent Program](https://gethomeoffer.com/real-estate-agent-program/): How a traditional sale with a local real estate professional works.
